name: Lavender County
source:
Deep down in the dirty south, the down-and-out residents of Lavender County smell somethin' in the spring air. Could it be love? Or is it just you?

[From [url=https://droptineart.itch.io/lavender-county]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在肮脏的南方深处，薰衣草县的穷困居民在春天的空气中闻到了某种味道。这会是爱情吗？或者只是你？

[来自[url=https://droptineart.itch.io/lavender-county]Itch.io[/url]]
